parameters.content:
## 1. TRIGGER & CLEANUP
Runs on schedule (+ 2 fallback triggers at +4 and +9 min in case the primary doesn't fire), then does a full sweep of every temp/used file from the previous render so each run starts fast and clean.

## 2. TREND RESEARCH & TOPIC SELECTION
Pulls fresh trend signals, reads the FULL Google Sheet history, removes duplicates, and narrows it down to a Top 5 Unique Trends list (separate node - keeps the prompt short so the AI uses fewer tokens). That short list + the existing ban-list logic both feed the Script Writer.

## 3. AI SCRIPT GENERATION (multi-model fallback loop)
Config Center supplies the prompt + keys. Falls through the free-model queue until one succeeds.

nodes.name: Note: 3. AI SCRIPT GENERATION (multi-model fallback loop)

parameters.content:
## 4. FACT-CHECK, POLICY FILTER & DUPLICATE GUARD
Fact Checker now has its own dynamic free-model finder (same live-discovery pattern as the Script Writer, separate queue, smaller token budget since it's only checking an already-written short script) -> free LanguageTool grammar/spelling pass (no AI, no cost) -> banned-content/profanity scan -> duplicate detection. If the policy filter finds bad language, it loops back to the Script Writer to rewrite the SAME topic clean (up to 3 tries) instead of throwing the topic away; only after 3 failed rewrites does it fall back to a new topic.

nodes.name: Note: 4. FACT-CHECK, POLICY FILTER & DUPLICATE GUARD

parameters.content:
## 5. SCENE PREP & IMAGE PROMPTS
Splits the 5-scene script and refines each scene's image prompt using its own dynamic free-model finder (Gemini first, live OpenRouter free models as fallback - same pattern as the Script Writer, no paid API).

## 6. IMAGE GENERATION PIPELINE
Generates + validates each scene's image with 3 independent free fallbacks (Pollinations gptimage-large -> gpt-image-2 -> flux, all free/no-key), plus up to 3 full retries if every fallback fails on a given scene.

## 7. VOICE & CLIP RENDERING
TTS per scene (free Edge-TTS -> silent fallback, no paid API), then assembles the final clip.

## 8. THUMBNAIL, METADATA & UPLOAD
Builds the thumbnail + YouTube metadata, uploads, then pins a comment.

## 9. VIDEO QUALITY CONTROL
Vision-model review of sampled frames using its own dynamic free VISION-model finder (Gemini first, live OpenRouter free vision models as fallback). If every free vision model fails, QC is marked unavailable-but-passed rather than blocking the upload or costing money. Low scores trigger an alert email.

## 10. WRAP-UP & NOTIFICATIONS
Final cleanup, run log, and a success ping.

## 11. ERROR HANDLING
Catches any workflow failure, logs it, cleans up, and alerts you.

cd /tmp && sort -V -t'|' -k1 srt_lines.txt > srt_sorted.txt && python3 - <<'PYEOF' > full.srt
import re

def fmt(t):
    if t < 0: t = 0
    h = int(t // 3600); m = int((t % 3600) // 60); s = t % 60
    return ("%02d:%02d:%06.3f" % (h, m, s)).replace('.', ',')

HL_OPEN = '<font color="#FF4500">'
HL_CLOSE = '</font>'

def pick_key_word(words):
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in w):
            return i
    best_i, best_len = 0, 0
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        cw = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z]', '', w)
        if len(cw) > best_len:
            best_len = len(cw); best_i = i
    return best_i

idx = 1
start = 0.0
with open('srt_sorted.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split('|', 2)
        if len(parts) < 3:
            continue
        _, dur_s, text = parts
        try:
            dur = float(dur_s)
        except ValueError:
            dur = 8.0
        words = text.split()
        chunk_size = 4
        chunks = [words[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(words), chunk_size)] or [['']]
        n = len(chunks)
        per = dur / n
        for ci, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
            c_start = start + ci * per
            c_end = c_start + per
            ki = pick_key_word(chunk) if any(chunk) else 0
            rendered = []
            for wi, w in enumerate(chunk):
                if wi == ki and w:
                    rendered.append(HL_OPEN + w + HL_CLOSE)
                else:
                    rendered.append(w)
            print(idx)
            print("%s --> %s" % (fmt(c_start), fmt(c_end)))
            print(' '.join(rendered))
            print()
            idx += 1
        start += dur
PYEOF
echo SRT_BUILT && cat full.srt && rm -f srt_sorted.txt

cd /tmp && ls clip_*.mp4 | sort -V | sed "s/^/file '/;s/$/'/" > concat.txt && ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f concat -safe 0 -i concat.txt -c copy /tmp/merged.mp4 && test -s /tmp/merged.mp4 || exit 1; HAS_A=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 /tmp/merged.mp4 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$HAS_A" ]; then echo MERGED_NO_AUDIO_FIX; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i /tmp/merged.mp4 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 128k -shortest /tmp/merged2.mp4 2>/dev/null && mv -f /tmp/merged2.mp4 /tmp/merged.mp4; fi; if [ -s /tmp/bgm.mp3 ]; then ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -filter_threads 1 -filter_complex_threads 1 -i /tmp/merged.mp4 -stream_loop -1 -i /tmp/bgm.mp3 -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=0.12[bg];[0:a][bg]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=2[aout]" -map 0:v -map "[aout]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -ac 1 -max_muxing_queue_size 1024 -shortest /tmp/withaudio.mp4 2>/dev/null || cp /tmp/merged.mp4 /tmp/withaudio.mp4; else cp /tmp/merged.mp4 /tmp/withaudio.mp4; fi && rm -f /tmp/clip_*.mp4 /tmp/merged.mp4 && { [ -s /tmp/full.srt ] || printf "1

parameters.name: seed
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const s = String($('Prep Scene').item.json.image_prompt || ''); let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = (Math.imul(31, h) + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; } return Math.abs(h) % 99999; })() }}

### Fallback Triggers
Only run if the primary trigger's run hasn't started yet today (checked via a shared guard). Prevents duplicate runs.

### 3rd Image Fallback
Uses Pollinations flux model (free, no key) as a third, independent fallback if both other image models fail. Same input (Prep Scene image_prompt) and output (binary file) as the other two.
